post.description:
Ask a question and get an answer that Claude wrote after searching the live web. Send a normal Messages request — a `messages` array plus `max_tokens` — and the endpoint injects a fixed, server-pinned model and the `web_search` tool for you; you cannot override the model or add tools, which keeps cost bounded. Claude decides when to search (up to `max_uses` searches, default 5), reads the results, and answers with inline citations. The response is a standard Anthropic Messages object: `content[]` contains `server_tool_use` (the queries issued), `web_search_tool_result` (the sources found) and `text` blocks (the answer with `citations`), and `usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests` reports how many searches were billed.  a failed search (HTTP 200 `web_search_tool_result_error`) is not billed. Use this when you want a written, cited answer grounded in current web content — for open-web research that returns ranked links and page text in one call use [`post_tavily_search`](/api-reference/search/post_tavily-search) instead, and for the OpenAI-model equivalent see [`post_openai_websearch_search`](/api-reference/search/post_openai-websearch-search).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.3 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

messages.content: What are the three biggest AI announcements this week? Give one sentence each with sources.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the answer. Required by the upstream Messages API.

messages.description: Conversation messages, same format as the Anthropic Messages API. The user turn holds your question.

example.content: What are the three biggest AI announcements this week? Give one sentence each with sources.

content.description: Message text. Structured content blocks are also accepted.

system.description: Optional system prompt to steer the answer's tone or format.

content.description: Ordered blocks: server_tool_use (search queries), web_search_tool_result (sources), and text (the cited answer).

200.description: A standard Anthropic Messages response. `content[]` interleaves the searches performed and the cited answer; `usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests` is the billed search count.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats
